consent.description: Request-level consent applied to every user in the request. A user-level consent inside an event overrides it.

destinations.description: Where the events go. Each entry carries operatingAccount {accountType, accountId} and productDestinationId, which for Google Ads is the conversion action id.

encoding.description: Encoding of hashed user identifiers. Required only for userData uploads, not for click-id conversions.

encryptionInfo.description: Encryption details for userData uploads. Omit when identifiers are hashed but not encrypted.

events.description: The events to send. At most 2000 per request. Each carries eventTimestamp, eventSource (WEB, APP, IN_STORE, PHONE, MESSAGE, or OTHER), adIdentifiers {gclid|gbraid|wbraid}, conversionValue, currency, and transactionId.

validateOnly.description: Validate the batch without recording it. Status lookup is unavailable for validation requests.
